$comment: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL production advisories (phase 11 M3). Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package, a justification, a severity, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) that is at most 7 days (critical) or 30 days (high) after addedAt (ADR-028); an expired entry blocks again (in diff mode only when the change introduces the finding; the nightly scan always). Checked by apps/api/scripts/security/audit-gate.ts. "imageExceptions" are the accepted Trivy findings of the Docker images (OS packages, and the library findings of the nightly scan): each has a CVE id, severity, reason and expiry under the same limits, and must match .trivyignore exactly (apps/api/test/unit/image-exceptions.test.ts).

exceptions.reason: postcss 8.4.31 is pinned by next 15.5 and only processes our own CSS at build time; the file read needs an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS, which never reaches it.
Same dependency path as above (next > postcss 8.4.31): only our own, build-time CSS is processed; no untrusted CSS input exists in the product.

Only inside the Prisma CLI config loader (@prisma/config), which merges only our own prisma.config.ts; the stack exhaustion needs an attacker-supplied recursive object graph, which never reaches it. Prisma is pinned at 7.10.0 (ADR / CLAUDE.md).
Transitive dependency of the Prisma CLI; SmartOps uses PostgreSQL only, the MySQL driver is never loaded.

imageExceptions.reason: CRITICAL: perl: incorrect regular expression processing. Perl comes from the Debian 12 base image (node:24.21.0-bookworm-slim, republished 2026-10-06 still with deb12u3); neither the API nor the panel runs Perl, and no user input ever reaches it. Short exception until Debian publishes the fix in the node image. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-13221
imageExceptions.removeWhen: Renovate (or a manual digest bump) moves node:24.21.0-bookworm-slim to a digest with perl-base 5.36.0-7+deb12u4: delete this entry and its line in .trivyignore in that same PR.
